title.fa: کربلا و حسین بن علی: رویداد و جای آن در حافظهٔ شیعی
title.en: Karbala and Husayn ibn Ali: the event and its place in Shi'i memory
title.nl: Karbala en Husayn ibn Ali: de gebeurtenis en het sjiitische geheugen

summary.fa: مومن از دید یک پژوهشگر، زنجیرهٔ رویدادها را از صلح امام حسن با معاویه تا کشته‌شدن حسین در کربلا بازمی‌گوید و نشان می‌دهد چرا این واقعه برای شیعیان هستهٔ هویت دینی شد.
summary.en: Momen narrates, as a scholar, the chain from Hasan's settlement with Mu'awiya to Husayn's death at Karbala, and why the event became the core of Shi'i religious identity.
summary.nl: Momen schetst de keten van Hasans overeenkomst met Mu'awiya tot Husayns dood bij Karbala en waarom dit de kern van de sjiitische identiteit werd.

text.fa: حسن بن علی، امام دوم، از درگیری با معاویه کناره گرفت و خلافت را رها کرد؛ در روایت شیعی بعدها به دستور معاویه مسموم شد.
text.en: Hasan, the second Imam, withdrew from the struggle with Mu'awiya and gave up the caliphate; Shi'i tradition says he was later poisoned at Mu'awiya's instigation.
text.nl: Hasan, the second Imam, withdrew from the struggle with Mu'awiya and gave up the caliphate; Shi'i tradition says he was later poisoned at Mu'awiya's instigation.

text.fa: معاویه با نامزدکردن پسرش یزید، خلافت را موروثی کرد و این کار با وعدهٔ پیشین دربارهٔ جانشینی ناسازگار بود؛ حسین، امام سوم (زاده ۴ هجری)، از بیعت با یزید سر باز زد.
text.en: By naming his son Yazid heir, Mu'awiya made the caliphate hereditary, which clashed with earlier undertakings; Husayn, the third Imam (born AH 4), refused allegiance to Yazid.
text.nl: By naming his son Yazid heir, Mu'awiya made the caliphate hereditary, which clashed with earlier undertakings; Husayn, the third Imam (born AH 4), refused allegiance to Yazid.

text.fa: حسین به دعوت نامه‌های کوفیان راهی عراق شد؛ در راه سپاه حُر او را متوقف کرد، سپس عمر بن سعد به فرمان والی عبیدالله بن زیاد او را محاصره کرد و راه نهر را بست.
text.en: Husayn set out for Iraq on the strength of letters from the Kufans; he was stopped by the force of al-Hurr, then besieged by Umar ibn Sa'd on the governor Ubaydallah ibn Ziyad's orders, who cut access to the river.
text.nl: Husayn set out for Iraq on the strength of letters from the Kufans; he was stopped by the force of al-Hurr, then besieged by Umar ibn Sa'd on the governor Ubaydallah ibn Ziyad's orders, who cut access to the river.

text.fa: حسین با نمایندهٔ سپاه مذاکره کرد و خواست اجازه دهند بازگردد؛ پیشنهاد او پذیرفته نشد و او و یارانش کشته شدند (محرم ۶۱ ه/ ۶۸۰ م).
text.en: Husayn negotiated and asked to be allowed to return; this was refused and he and his companions were killed (Muharram AH 61 / 680 CE).
text.nl: Husayn negotiated and asked to be allowed to return; this was refused and he and his companions were killed (Muharram AH 61 / 680 CE).

text.fa: برای شیعیان، کربلا نماد ایستادگی در برابر ستم و مرکز آیین‌های عزاداری و زیارت شد؛ مومن شرح آن را برای فهم باورهای شیعه ضروری می‌داند.
text.en: For Shi'is Karbala became the symbol of standing against injustice and the centre of mourning rites and pilgrimage; Momen treats understanding it as essential for grasping Shi'ism.
text.nl: For Shi'is Karbala became the symbol of standing against injustice and the centre of mourning rites and pilgrimage; Momen treats understanding it as essential for grasping Shi'ism.

text.fa: حاشیه‌های نسخهٔ فارسی (ک‌ـ‌ح) روایت کربلا را ابزار «فریب مردم» و روحانیت را مسئول می‌خوانند و کلیت آیین عزاداری را بی‌ارزش می‌شمارند؛ این نظر حاشیه‌نویس است نه مومن، و داوری ارزشی است نه یافتهٔ تاریخی.
text.en: Marginal notes in the Persian edition (K-H) present the Karbala story as a tool for deceiving the public and blame the clergy; this is the annotator's evaluative opinion, not Momen's and not a historical finding.
text.nl: Marginal notes in the Persian edition (K-H) present the Karbala story as a tool for deceiving the public and blame the clergy; this is the annotator's evaluative opinion, not Momen's and not a historical finding.

text.fa: در پژوهش دانشگاهی، جزئیات روایت کربلا بر منابع متأخرتر و مقتل‌ها تکیه دارد و گزارش‌های اولیه ساده‌ترند؛ اما اصل رخداد و کشته‌شدن حسین مورد پذیرش مورخان است.
text.en: Academic historians note the detailed Karbala narrative draws on later maqtal literature while early reports are plainer, but the event itself and Husayn's death are accepted as historical.
text.nl: Academic historians note the detailed Karbala narrative draws on later maqtal literature while early reports are plainer, but the event itself and Husayn's death are accepted as historical.
